value: A Phase 2A.2 projected pack gains an immutable sealed active-run binding; active-run resolution validates that exact pack and ignores later current.json changes; the official Requirements adapter reads only from the validated frozen pack; bounded legacy-v1 continuation remains read-only and cannot authorize a new Full run; status is read-only and explicit provision reuses the offline Phase 2A.2 transaction.
tailtrail/aidlc_bundle.py owns binding, resolution, compatibility, status, and provision service behavior; scripts/official-aidlc-requirements.py separately owns frozen-pack Requirements lookup.

TAILTRAIL-BUNDLED-OFFLINE-AIDLC-PROVISIONING-DESIGN.md is inspection-only because it defines Phase 2 migration, frozen binding, Requirements lookup, status, provision, safety, compatibility, and proof boundaries but is not an implementation target.

scripts/aidlc-official-bridge.py is inspection-only because its existing bridge contract supplies the compatibility and official identity fields consumed by the Requirements adapter; Phase 3 will wire the new binding into bridge creation.

scripts/aidlc-official-detect.py is inspection-only because it defines current legacy-v1 and bundled-v2 compatibility classification; Phase 2B must preserve that compatibility boundary without editing the public detector.

scripts/planning_lock.py is inspection-only because it is the later Phase 3 owner that will persist and route the frozen binding; this Phase 2B slice provides the service contract but does not wire Planning Lock.

scripts/official-aidlc-state.py is inspection-only because it owns the existing canonical official run-state projection and identity consistency rules that the new binding must not duplicate or contradict.
schemas/official-aidlc-pack.schema.json is inspection-only because it defines the existing legacy-v1 and bundled-v2 pack boundary; Phase 2B consumes those classifications and adds no schema file.

tests/test_aidlc_official_bridge.py is inspection-only because it demonstrates the production bridge and Requirements call shape, but its broad baseline currently has two unrelated planning-audit activation errors; Phase 2B proof is therefore isolated in the green focused resolver module instead of treating this failing broad suite as authoritative proof.
